text_block_list.text:
Spirits are high at Академия Тайсен's
public scrimmage. Among them,
one
student in particular is receiving a lot of
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Хару Урара still trails behind the others,
but one look at her face and
you know
she's not giving up! Look at her go!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: It's not... over yet!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: That's it, Urara! Go!
text_block_list.name: Farmer

text_block_list.text:
She's picking up speed, but it's no good!
The other Umamusume are
still out of her
reach! Will Хару Урара give up hope?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Urgh... Never! Just... you... watch!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Finiiish!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Хару Урара's growing popularity has
nothing to do with her speed, or
even her
form...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good job, Urara! You sure put up a fight
on the final stretch!
text_block_list.name: Neighbor Lady

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! I might've lost, but I'll take
home the gold next time
for sure!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
What garners people's attention is her
unwavering resolve. No matter
how bitter
the loss, she still marches on with a smile
on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: So? How'd I do? What was my time?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: A little slower than your best, I'm afraid...

text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! I coulda sworn I beat it! Oh
well, guess I'll have to work
even harder at
practice tomorrow!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could I have a moment of your
time?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a woman holding a camera
approaches us. She hands me a
business
card.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm? "Umamusume Monthly"? You write
for this magazine?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
That I do! And I've also been a fan of yours
since the tryouts!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Really?! Ehehe, thanks for the support!
Hm? Do you take pictures for
the
magazine too?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Yes! I got some really nice shots of you
running today!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Can I see?! What do I look like
when I'm running?! Show me!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all right, all right. I'll pick out a few
especially nice shots and
send them your
way.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
True to her word, we receive photographs
from the reporter several
days later.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow! I look so cute in these! Ah, but look
at how flared my nostrils
are in this one!
Aw geez...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: She also wrote you a message of support.

text_block_list.text:
Whoa... She's saying such nice things
about me! Ehehe... Ah, she even
mentions
you!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
"Ever since you started working with your
trainer, your smile's gotten
even brighter."
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
"That must be one heck of a trainer." Did
you hear that?! She really
likes you!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Same here!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I'm not the only one people cheer for. If I
do well, people will cheer
for you too...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Guess I have another reason to
work hard!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
